faq.q1_a: Your messages are encrypted on your device before being sent and can only be decrypted by the recipient. Neither E-discussion nor anyone else can read their content.
faq.q2_q: How do I block or report someone?
faq.q2_a: Open the person's profile (from a chat or their contact page), then at the bottom of the screen choose "Block" or "Report".
faq.q3_q: Why am I not getting notifications in the background?
faq.q3_a: Some phones (Infinix, Tecno, Itel, Xiaomi…) restrict background apps to save battery. Go to Settings > Notifications and allow E-discussion to run without restrictions.
faq.q4_q: How do I change my phone number?
faq.q4_a: Go to Settings > Account > Identifiers, then link a new number. Contact support if you no longer have access to your old number.
faq.q5_q: How does channel live broadcasting work?
faq.q5_a: Channel admins can start a live video broadcast visible to all subscribers in real time, from the channel settings.
faq.q6_q: How do I delete my account?
faq.q6_a: Go to Settings > Account > Delete my account. This action is permanent: all your conversations, statuses, and created groups will be deleted.
faq.q7_a: No. Once deleted (for you or for everyone), messages can't be restored.
faq.q8_a: Yes, E-discussion is entirely free: messaging, calls, and live broadcasts included.

terms.intro: Welcome to E-discussion. By using our app, you agree to these terms of use. Please read them carefully.
terms.s1_body: By creating an account or using E-discussion, you agree to be bound by these terms of use and our privacy policy.
terms.s2_body: You must be at least 13 years old to use E-discussion. By using the app, you confirm you meet this requirement.
terms.s3_body: You are responsible for keeping your account confidential and for any activity on it. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.
terms.s4_body: You agree not to use E-discussion to harass, threaten, impersonate others, distribute illegal content, spam, or engage in fraudulent activity.
terms.s5_body: You retain ownership of the content you post (messages, photos, statuses). You are solely responsible for this content and must hold the rights necessary to share it.
terms.s6_body: Messages exchanged on E-discussion are end-to-end encrypted. We cannot access the content of your private conversations.
terms.s7_body: You may report a profile or content that violates these terms. We reserve the right to suspend or remove any account that breaks these rules.
terms.s8_body: Channel live broadcasts are visible to subscribers in real time. Channel admins are responsible for the broadcast content.
terms.s9_body: We may suspend or terminate your access to E-discussion for serious or repeated violations of these terms.
terms.s10_body: You may delete your account at any time from settings. This action is permanent and irreversible.
terms.s11_body: We may update these terms occasionally. Significant changes will be notified within the app.
terms.s12_body: For any questions about these terms, contact us via the "Contact us" section in settings.

privacyDoc.intro: This policy describes how E-discussion collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
privacyDoc.s1_body: Phone number, display name, profile photo (optional), and technical metadata needed to run the service (device identifiers, notification tokens).
privacyDoc.s2_body: The content of your messages is end-to-end encrypted: we cannot read it, store it in plain text, or share it with third parties.
privacyDoc.s3_body: Your data is used solely to run the app: delivering your messages, showing your presence status according to your privacy settings, and sending you notifications.
privacyDoc.s4_body: We do not sell or share your personal data with advertisers or third parties for commercial purposes.
privacyDoc.s5_body: You control who can see your profile photo, last seen, about status, and online presence, from Settings > Privacy.
privacyDoc.s6_body: If you sync your address book, phone numbers are used only temporarily to identify contacts already on the app — they are not stored in plain text on our servers.
privacyDoc.s7_body: Messages are kept encrypted until deleted by you or your contact. Statuses expire automatically after 24 hours.
privacyDoc.s8_body: We use end-to-end encryption for messages and encryption in transit (TLS) for all communication with our servers.
privacyDoc.s9_body: You can export your data at any time (Settings > Account > Export my data) or permanently delete your account and all associated data.
privacyDoc.s10_body: For any questions about your personal data, contact us via the "Contact us" section in settings.
